pages.title: Deep Sea Ripple
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Boots$(br2)§lEffect: §r Grants 1.6× movement speed while sneaking in water; the boost ends immediately upon leaving water or releasing sneak. Conflicts with Depth Strider, Frost Walker, Soul Speed, Wind Ripple and Elegant Catwalk.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Fishing
